name: kunduz-university-certificate-system
description: Offline Certificate Request and Printing System for Kunduz University (Ministry of Higher Education, Afghanistan)

scripts.install:all: PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:offline: PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true npm --prefix server ci --offline --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client ci --offline --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.prepare:offline-cache: PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true npm --prefix server ci --cache ../offline/npm-cache && npm --prefix client ci --cache ../offline/npm-cache
scripts.start: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('client/dist/index.html'))require('child_process').execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'})" && npm --prefix server run start
